summary: A first-week one-on-one with the manager is followed by a bigger work network and more teamwork.
realLife: A Microsoft analysis of about 3,000 new hires, as summarized by Atlassian, linked a first-week manager one-on-one to a larger internal network, better meetings and more collaboration.
sources: Atlassian Work Life, starting a new job and first week success: https://www.atlassian.com/blog/teamwork/starting-a-new-job-and-first-week-success
inGame: Needs: a tie-growth read tied to tenure; the coworker ties between people at one workplace can carry it, aged by tenure in the job record (employer, position, workplace, pay, tenure) in the jobs module.
